# Repositories whose open issues do NOT go on the project board.
#
# Read by `.github/scripts/board-triage.sh admit`, which puts every open issue in
# every non-archived repository of the organisation on the board once a pass
# (`kolonie-docs#332`). This file is the only way out of that.
#
# **It is an opt-out, and that is the whole design.** A repository created
# tomorrow is covered with no edit here and no edit anywhere else, because the
# sweep reads the organisation's repository list rather than a list somebody
# maintains. The five `Auto-add to project` workflows on the board still run and
# are still correct; they are no longer what coverage depends on, because a
# project takes at most five of them and the organisation passed five
# repositories some time ago.
#
# **One repository per line, the bare name, and a sentence above it saying why.**
# A line without a reason is a line nobody can decide about later — including the
# person wondering whether the repository it names should still be excluded.
# Blank lines and `#` lines are ignored. An archived repository does not belong
# here: the sweep already skips those, and listing one hides the fact that it is
# archived behind a decision that was never made.

# The organisation profile: its issues are about this file's own README and the
# organisation page, and there is no work in it for an agent to pick up. It has
# no `AGENTS.md`, so the worker could not act on one of its issues even if the
# board offered it.
.github
